description.es: Mientras Damián y Tasio se ocupan de Eladio, Eladio saca una pistola, y Tasio resulta herido al salvar a Damián. Marta y Pelayo hablan de negocios, y Pelayo le dice que no pasa nada porque haya rechazado la cena y que no se preocupe.
description.en: While Damián and Tasio are dealing with Eladio, Eladio pulls out a gun, and Tasio is wounded saving Damián. Marta and Pelayo talk about business, and Pelayo tells her that it is not a problem that she turned down dinner and that she should not worry.
